headlines.headline: Giants expect Nabers, Thomas, Skattebo and Likely to play Sunday
headlines.description: New York Giants wide receiver Malik Nabers is expected to play Sunday against the Washington Commanders after missing a practice earlier in the week because of knee soreness.

headlines.headline: Jeremiyah Love 'trending well' to play despite ankle reinjury
headlines.description: Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love aggravated his ankle injury last week against the Giants. He was limited in practice this week but is trending to play against the Lions.

headlines.headline: Chargers LT Rashawn Slater on IR following ankle surgery
headlines.description: The Chargers are placing Rashawn Slater on injured reserve after the left tackle had surgery for a high ankle sprain. Los Angeles will be without three of its starting offensive linemen against the Broncos on Sunday.

headlines.headline: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle/foot) questionable vs. Pats
headlines.description: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Friday that RB Ashton Jeanty was questionable to play against the Patriots as he deals with ankle and foot injuries.

headlines.headline: Bears RB Monangai out, QB Williams now questionable vs. Packers
headlines.description: The Bears have ruled RB Kyle Monangai out for Sunday's matchup against the Packers, while QB Caleb Williams is questionable after being a limited participant in Friday's practice.

headlines.headline: Sources: Eagles release Andy Dalton after costly pick, demotion
headlines.description: Andy Dalton, who lost his spot as the Eagles' backup quarterback following a costly interception against the Bears, has been released, sources told NFL Network.

headlines.headline: Panthers eyeing six-week timeline for Brad Marchand's return
headlines.description: The Panthers are expecting forward Brad Marchand to miss about six weeks with his left leg injury, a timeline that coincides with Aleksander Barkov being out six to eight weeks.
